description: Are these postings still on the board? Answers up to 200 ids in one call — the tool for re-verifying a saved shortlist before acting on it, instead of spending a metered get_job per posting. Returns open:{id:boolean} plus the closed ids, and names the basis of the answer: it reads the board's index (a closed posting is one the employer's feed stopped listing), not the employer's site at this instant, and it is a weaker test than get_job's — read `basis` before reporting a posting as live to a person. Needs a key or a sign-in.

ids.description: Job ids from search_jobs. Up to 200 per call; anything past that is named in notChecked rather than silently dropped.

name: check_jobs_open

closed.description: The ids that are no longer on the board.

title: Check which jobs are still open
